specialist.qualification: TOURNAMENT runtime: 30 days, one train, save/load healthy

native_probes.catalog: runtime RailTypeInfo and train Engine projection
native_probes.construction: all track orientations, slopes, junctions, rail and road crossings, ownership, failures, station/depot/waypoint lifecycle, and conversion
native_probes.freight: real refitted coal train traversing a native route and receiving final-delivery income
native_probes.lifecycle: locomotive/wagon consist, refit, orders, timetable, service interval, clone, autoreplace, and sale
native_probes.passenger: real passenger train traversing a native route and receiving final-delivery income
native_probes.signals: six signal types in electric and semaphore variants plus reservation acquire/reject/release
native_probes.stress: two trains on a junction-connected two-platform physical network with a shared destination, path signals, a 32768-tick soak, bounded wait, delivery, and collision/deadlock checks

observation_extension.m15_compatibility: append-only typed extension; M15 tensor and candidate bytes remain unchanged

semantics.competence: passenger and freight service must produce positive delivery and income against frozen zero-service comparators on two deterministic seeds each
semantics.exact_replay: every native case runs in two fresh processes with normalized byte-identical reports
semantics.loading_fixture: deterministic station packets are loaded through the native StationCargoList into real consists before vehicle ticks
semantics.save_load: M15 exact save/load replay remains a required regression dependency; M17 adds fresh-process exact twins around rail trajectories
semantics.scenario_setup: empty-map source packets and sink acceptance are bounded qualification fixtures; construction, consist management, pathfinding, movement, delivery, and payment are native
